title: Sarofang
extract:
The  Sarofang is  Voruna's signature axe heavy blade. Heavy Attack Slams with an 8x Combo Multiplier creates a vortex that pulls in hit enemies. When wielded by Voruna, the pull requirement is reduced to 5x Combo Multiplier.

Characteristics
This weapon deals primarily  Slash damage.
Stance slot has  polarity, matching  Rending Crane and  Noble Cadence (Conclave only) stance.
Performing a Heavy Attack Slam with an 8x Combo Multiplier (5x with  Voruna ( Prime)) briefly pulls enemies within 9m toward the center of the slam.

Acquisition
 Sarofang's blueprint and components can be obtained from Conjunction Survival Yuvarium and Circulus on Lua, whose access requires completion of The War Within; the blueprint comes from Rotation A, while the Blade and Handle come from Rotation B.
Alternatively they can be purchased from Archimedean Yonta on the Chrysalith, Zariman Ten Zero (requires completion of Angels of the Zariman to access) with  Lua Thrax Plasm, awarded from Conjunction Survival in quantities of 3 (Yuvarium), 5 (Circulus or Yuvarium Steel Path), or 6 (Circulus Steel Path) per rotation or dropped by Hollow Thrax Centurion and Hollow Thrax Legatus that appears at the end of every Conjunction Survival rotation at a 30% drop rate; each component requires 50, while the blueprint requires 100, totaling to 200 Lua Thrax Plasm.
All components can be traded between players, but not the blueprint.

All drop rates data is obtained from DE's official drop tables stored on Module:DropTables/data.

Notes
When wielded by  Voruna ( Prime), the Heavy Attack Slam vortex requirement is reduced to 5x Combo Multiplier.

Trivia
The name could be a reference to the World of Warcraft character Saurfang, an axe-wielding orc.
